title: PREFERENCES / OPERATIONS
description: Terminal preference modules. Active UI preferences are stored locally in the browser; operating rules and issued history remain repository-controlled.

active.label: ACTIVE
active.meaning: The module is operational in the terminal now.

display_only.label: DISPLAY ONLY
display_only.meaning: The module is fully presented in F6 but is intentionally not changeable from the terminal.

reserved.label: RESERVED
reserved.meaning: The module has a permanent home in F6 but its controls are not activated yet.

modules.title: SCHEDULE PROFILE
modules.summary: Seasonal odds-pulse, report-window and Vig Scope checkpoint schedule for the current Vancouver operating day.
modules.controlPolicy: The run is the run: once the operating day is assigned a schedule profile, F6 observes it and does not change it.

modules.title: HISTORY TRANSLATION
modules.summary: Canonical S1-S5 translation keeps previous-day comparisons meaningful across seasonal schedule profiles.
modules.controlPolicy: Operational automatically. Actual issue times, feed timestamps and archived payloads remain immutable.

modules.title: METER PRESENTATION
modules.summary: Choose the existing Vig Scope input-meter renderer.
modules.controlPolicy: Presentation only. Changing meter style does not alter Market Heat, Price Pressure, Market Agreement or Vig Scope state.

modules.title: SYNDICATE LOAD
modules.summary: Set the saved F1-F4 Hotline Unit assignments used when the Syndicate workspace loads.
modules.controlPolicy: Local UI preference. Character content and archived hotlines are unchanged.

modules.title: HOTLINE SHELLS
modules.summary: Show the approved visual shell, version and lock state for every saved Syndicate character.
modules.controlPolicy: Repository-controlled presentation registry. Normal Hotline refreshes preserve the active approved shell. Shell installation, purchasing and switching are not enabled from F6 yet.

modules.title: STARTUP SCREEN
modules.summary: Choose which existing terminal view opens when the runner loads.
modules.controlPolicy: Applies on the next runner load. It does not change report generation.

modules.title: HISTORY LANDING VIEW
modules.summary: Choose the first Bet History subpage shown when F3 opens.
modules.controlPolicy: Navigation preference only. History data, grading and archived records are unchanged.

modules.title: RECOMMENDATION DETAIL
modules.summary: Choose the default state of expandable recommendation analysis panels.
modules.controlPolicy: Presentation only. Expanding or collapsing analysis never changes a recommendation.

modules.title: TERMINAL INTERFACE
modules.summary: Future home for additional terminal-level display preferences that should not be scattered through the runner.
modules.controlPolicy: Reserved structure only; no existing runner behavior is changed.
